periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Near-vertical orientation with a slight inward tilt toward the nasal bridge, approximately 80 degrees relative to the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: High vertical-to-horizontal ratio, appearing as elongated ovals approximately twice as tall as they are wide.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward elongation forming a teardrop shape where the bulk of the black pigment resides below the ocular center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, shallow U-shaped curvature along the posterior margin where the black shoulder band meets the white dorsal fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Extends approximately one-third of the way down the visible trunk from the base of the neck.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A wide gap approximately equal to 1.2 times the lateral width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Consistent smooth, convex semicircular profile at the superior edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-tan chromogenic variation in the fur of the ventral abdomen and inner thighs, contrasting with the white cranial fur.
